title: The reseal door's pulse-path tooth reds a reach, never a compared string
intention: The reseal door's pulse-path tooth reds a pulse surface that REACHES the door (imports it, or hands a reseal string to a call that runs or loads code), and no longer reds a pulse surface that only names the door's caller string as data to compare against.
why: Measured 2026-10-30: bin/cairn test --exec over cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_reseal_door.py reds test_no_pulse_path_reaches_the_door on cairn/devices/tester/probes/a_commit_that_reseals_leaves_a_clean_tree.py, whose only 'reseal' in code is _RESEAL_CALLER = "cairn test --reseal" (:51), compared at :91 against a validation record's caller. The probe runs only git status and never reaches the door. The tooth guards the beat from minutes of proof runs; a compared string runs nothing, so this red does not serve the tooth's goal (the 2026-10-29 fake-failure ruling). It holds component_color red for every tester ticket.
traces_to: Law 9 (a PROVED proof gone red is red until fixed); Law 4 (the no-pulse-path rule is physics, and the physics should measure the rule's own claim: reach); 1accdc1781aa's narrowing from prose to code, extended by the same argument from data to reach.
how: EXISTS cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_reseal_door.py with test_no_pulse_path_reaches_the_door and _code_without_prose. The tooth's substring test becomes an AST reach reader (D1); a fixture tooth proves each reach shape reds and a comparison does not (D2).
falsifier: Falsifier: Done when cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_reseal_door.py, under PROVES for 36098e56d7d6 key 'all', runs green twice under bin/cairn test --exec with cairn/devices/tester/probes/a_commit_that_reseals_leaves_a_clean_tree.py byte-unchanged, and the new tooth test_the_pulse_tooth_reds_each_reach_and_no_comparison is green: every reach-shape fixture file is flagged and the comparison-only file is not. Wrong intent if the probe is evaluated on the beat AND reaches the door some way the AST reading cannot see (then the probe moves, not the tooth). proven_by = cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_reseal_door.py.

decisions.text: D1: THE REACH READER. In cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_reseal_door.py add a module-level helper '_reaches_reseal(path) -> bool'. It parses the file with ast (on SyntaxError it returns 'reseal' in path.read_text() — an unparseable file is measured whole). It collects module-level string bindings (Assign/AnnAssign of a Name to a str constant, or to a list/tuple of str constants). It returns True if any Import alias name or ImportFrom module/alias contains 'reseal', or if any Call whose callee unparses (ast.unparse(node.func)) to one of subprocess.run, subprocess.call, subprocess.check_call, subprocess.check_output, subprocess.Popen, os.system, importlib.import_module, import_module, __import__, or starts with os.exec or os.spawn, has a positional or keyword argument that is a str constant containing 'reseal', a List/Tuple with such an element, or a Name bound at module level to such a value. In test_no_pulse_path_reaches_the_door keep the three surface lists and the empty-surface assert, and replace 'if "reseal" in _code_without_prose(path):' with 'if _reaches_reseal(path):'. Add to the tooth's docstring a paragraph stating the 2026-10-30 narrowing (data compared is not reach; open-1fd084bd6c01 is the answer it rests on) and its residue (a helper defined elsewhere that takes the string is not seen). Leave _code_without_prose defined if any other tooth uses it.

D2: THE FIXTURE TOOTH AND THE KEY. Add 'def test_the_pulse_tooth_reds_each_reach_and_no_comparison():' directly after test_no_pulse_path_reaches_the_door. It makes a dir with the file's existing scratch_dir helper and writes seven files: imp.py 'import cairn.devices.tester.reseal', frm.py 'from cairn.devices.tester.reseal import x', sh.py 'import subprocess
subprocess.run("cairn test --reseal", shell=True)', argv.py 'import subprocess
subprocess.run(["cairn", "test", "--reseal"])', name.py 'import subprocess
C = ["cairn", "test", "--reseal"]
subprocess.run(C)', dyn.py 'import importlib
importlib.import_module("cairn.devices.tester.reseal")', cmp.py 'C = "cairn test --reseal"
def f(r):
    return r.get("caller") == C'. It asserts _reaches_reseal is True for the first six and False for cmp.py, and returns True. Add it to the file's composite/main run order beside the tooth it proves, and add '"36098e56d7d6": {"all": "test_no_pulse_path_reaches_the_door"}' to PROVES (or the composite tooth's name if the file has one). Run: bin/cairn test --exec 'python3 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_reseal_door.py', twice. Hollow: bin/cairn test --hollow 36098e56d7d6 --proof cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_reseal_door.py (a proofs-only build; the plan names the skipped file).
